svg.title: Nguyen one-ended m-saddles: construction input
svg.desc: Normalized sphere of radius two intersecting a plane. The highlighted circle is replaced by a bent Scherk core. The smaller periodic wave represents the core symbolically, not a solved shrinker. For sufficiently large m the construction has genus m minus one and one conical end.

g.text: Genus m − 1; one end asymptotic to a cone.
The perturbation is established by gluing, not drawn here.
SCHEMATIC • construction input, not a computed surface
